successCriteria.description: The stage 4 login assertion in scripts/smoke.js verifies the login profile's id, email, and role equal the seeded employee's values (id 'smoke-employee', email 'smoke@example.com', role EmployeeRole.EMPLOYEE).

The stage 4 login assertion verifies the login profile object has exactly the 10 EmployeeProfile fields (id, employeeNumber, firstName, lastName, email, role, managerId, department, hireDate, employmentStatus) and no others.
The stage 4 login assertion verifies passwordHash and terminationDate are absent from the login profile object.

The stage 4 login assertion verifies the remaining seeded profile values: employeeNumber 'E-0001', firstName 'Smoke', lastName 'Test', managerId null, department null, hireDate '2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z', employmentStatus EmploymentStatus.ACTIVE.
The existing stage 4 token assertion (non-empty string token) and the 200 status check remain intact — the change extends, not weakens, the login stage.

constraints: The change is confined to the stage 4 login assertion in scripts/smoke.js (around line 230); stages 1–3d and 5–8 must not be weakened, deleted, or reordered.
The assertion must compare hireDate against the serialized ISO string '2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z' (the JSON wire form of the Date), not the raw seed string '2020-01-01'.
EmployeeRole and EmploymentStatus are already imported in the stage 3 import line and must be used directly rather than re-imported or hardcoded as bare strings.
outOfScope: No production code changes (AuthService, EmployeeProfile mapping, routes) — this phase only strengthens the existing smoke-test assertion against the already-shipped login behavior.

entityInvariants.invariant: A serialized EmployeeProfile exposes exactly 10 fields and never leaks passwordHash or terminationDate.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The 10-field profile shape asserted in stage 4 must match the EmployeeProfile interface (id, employeeNumber, firstName, lastName, email, role, managerId, department, hireDate, employmentStatus) with no passwordHash or terminationDate.
The stage 4 profile assertion must mirror the existing stage 5 /employees/me assertion pattern (same expected values, same absence checks for passwordHash/terminationDate).

The asserted seeded values must match the employee row inserted in stage 3d (id 'smoke-employee', employeeNumber 'E-0001', firstName 'Smoke', lastName 'Test', email 'smoke@example.com', role EmployeeRole.EMPLOYEE, managerId null, department null, hireDate '2020-01-01', employmentStatus EmploymentStatus.ACTIVE).

The login profile under test is produced by AuthService.login, which maps the Employee to EmployeeProfile via toEmployeeProfile and omits passwordHash/terminationDate; the assertion must reflect that contract.
